items.title: Case (1): Modes of vibrations in an organ pipe open at both ends (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Case (1): Modes of vibrations in an organ pipe open at both ends: a main subheading of 7.6 Stationary waves in air columns, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 150-150.

blocks.text: Length (lambai) l ka organ pipe lein jo dono siron se khula hai. Khule sire par hawa ka molecule poori azaadi se hil sakta hai, is liye wahan antinode banta hai, jaisa Fig. 7.8 mein hai. Is figure mein pipe ke andar ki longitudinal waves ko transverse (lehar jaisi) lines se dikhaya gaya hai; yeh lines pipe ke axis ke saath different (alag alag) points par hawa ke particles ka displacement aur amplitude batati hain.
Is case mein (Fig. 7.8 a) pipe ke beech mein sirf ek node N hai. Dono sire khule hain, is liye dono siron par antinodes hain. Agar sound ki wavelength λ₁ ho to:

blocks.alt: Dono siron se khule teen pipes, rang bhare displacement ke ghere ke sath. (a) beech mein ek node, l = lambda1/2, f1 = v/2l; (b) do nodes, l = 2(lambda2/2), f2 = 2(v/2l); (c) teen nodes, l = 3(lambda3/2), f3 = 3(v/2l). (a) aur (b) ke oopar hare do-teer antinodes aur nuqte nodes dikhate hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Khule sire par hawa azaad hai, is liye wahan antinode hai (hara do-teer: hawa aage peeche hilti hai). Wave jaisi shakal sirf hawa ki longitudinal motion ka andaza dikhati hai; asal mein hawa pipe ki length ki direction mein hilti hai. Har agle mode mein ek node barhta hai: f₁, 2f₁, 3f₁, yani saare harmonics.
Agar teen antinodes aur do nodes hon to frequency fundamental frequency ki double hoti hai. Yeh vibration ka doosra mode hai (Fig. 7.8 b), jis mein teen antinodes aur do nodes hain.
